dashboard_rules: F-pattern layout: North star metric top-left.

components.cards: Subtle border (border-border), flat background, no heavy drop shadows. Optional soft lift on hover (-translate-y-1).
components.buttons: Rounded edges (rounded-full or rounded-lg). High contrast text. Active states visibly darker.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but softened borders. Focus ring should use primary color (Moss Green).
components.charts: Recharts / Shadcn Chart components. Accessible tooltips and color-blind friendly palettes.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts and -translate-y-[2px] on interactive cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy. Do not use standard dark SaaS themes or neon colors.
Update `index.css` to inject the defined custom color variables into the `:root` pseudo-class. Map them exactly as provided.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid strategy for the dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Minimize empty space but maintain 'p-6' internal padding on cards.
For the City Analytics features, use the provided city_skyline images as subtle headers or background textures for city-specific cards.
For Volunteer/Charity threads, use the volunteer_group images as thumbnails or list avatars.

Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Cards, Tables, Select, DatePicker, Charts) but override their default borders to be softer (border-black/5 or border-border) and remove heavy drop shadows (use flat surfaces).
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Include a visible sidebar or top navigation bar that is not fully transparent. Avoid hiding links in hamburger menus on desktop.
Never use `Inter` or `Space Grotesk` fonts. Strictly use `Outfit` and `Manrope`.
Never use generic placeholder image URLs. Use the exact URLs from the `media` array.
